parameters.content:
## ⚙️ How to Setup

1. Google Sheets Trigger: Connect your Google account and select the specific spreadsheet and sheet to monitor for new client rows
2. OpenAI Chat Model: Add your OpenAI API key in the credentials
3. Gmail Tool: Connect your Gmail account for sending emails
4. Google Drive Tool: Connect your Google account for folder creation
5. Google Docs Tool: Connect your Google account for document creation
6. Workflow Configuration: Update the team email, company name, and base folder name to match your organization
7. Google Sheets: Ensure your sheet has columns for client name, email, company, project details, project manager, and project team contact email

## ℹ️ How to Use

Add a new row to your Google Sheets with client information. The AI agent will automatically:

* Send a welcome email to the client
* Create a project folder
* Generate a personalized onboarding checklist with kickoff call, 1-week check, and 1-month review
* Notify your team with client details and folder link
